announcements.headline: Completion of the Acquisition of GEM Newco Limited
announcements.insight: This acquisition marks a critical step in Earnz's strategy to consolidate the fragmented UK student accommodation market, moving from development to asset management. It validates the firm's pivot towards recurring yield but introduces integration risks typical of M&A in this sector.

announcements.insight: Completion of the acquisition marks a definitive step in Earnz's strategy to consolidate its position in the UK credit repair and debt management sector, potentially driving economies of scale but introducing integration risks.
